caveats.statement: gender 表中同时存在 'Female' 和 'Male' 两种写法,但问题中的 ratio 证据把 male/female 写反了,查询时需按实际 gender 值匹配,避免性别计数颠倒
caveats.check_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id GROUP BY gender

caveats.statement: attribute 表中属性名大小写不一致(如 'Strength' 与 'durability'),直接等值匹配会漏掉部分行
colour 表中存在 'No Colour' 这一特殊取值,表示没有颜色,不能当作 NULL 处理
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM colour WHERE colour = 'No Colour'

caveats.statement: publisher 表中 'DC Comics' 与 'Marvel Comics' 是不同行,但问题里常简写为 'DC' 或 'Marvel',需映射到完整名称
caveats.check_sql: SELECT id, publisher_name FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name IN ('DC Comics','Marvel Comics')

caveats.statement: superhero 表中 height_cm 和 weight_kg 可能为 NULL,做 AVG 或比较时需排除 NULL
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE height_cm IS NULL OR weight_kg IS NULL

caveats.statement: hero_attribute 与 hero_power 是多对多关系,直接 JOIN 会导致英雄行重复计数
caveats.check_sql: SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) FROM hero_power GROUP BY hero_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

caveats.statement: superpower 表中 'Super Strength' 可能与其他力量类能力名称相似,需精确匹配避免误计
caveats.check_sql: SELECT power_name FROM superpower WHERE power_name LIKE '%Strength%'

caveats.statement: alignment 表中 'Bad' 表示反派,但部分问题用 'villains' 表述,需映射到 alignment = 'Bad'
race 表中种族名称可能有多种写法(如 'Human' 与 'human'),直接匹配会漏行
superhero 表中 full_name 可能重复或为 NULL,按 full_name 查询时需确认唯一性
caveats.check_sql: SELECT full_name, COUNT(*) FROM superhero GROUP BY full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
